name: manual_26e03c
claim: Before correcting a peer's citation, read the record it cites; a commit named as a ratified base is a repo state, so its unrelated merge subject does not make it wrong

decisions.notes: Claude called the ratified base commit a mere Hermes merge; the ratification addendum names it as the base, so the correction itself was the error.

rationale: Claude called the ratified base commit a mere Hermes merge; the ratification addendum names it as the base, so the correction itself was the error.
